task: AI-guided inverse design of recyclable vitrimeric polymers

methods.md_simulation: Use provided MD Tg data (not re-run simulations)
methods.gp_calibration: Gaussian Process regression to calibrate MD Tg to experimental Tg using tg_calibration.csv, then apply to vitrimer MD data
methods.graph_vae: Graph Variational Autoencoder for generating new vitrimer chemistries from molecular graph representations
methods.inverse_design: Use trained GP + VAE to generate candidates with target Tg properties
methods.validation: Computational validation of generated candidates (chemical validity, property prediction)

key_commitments: GP calibration model trained on experimental vs MD Tg data
Screening candidates for desired Tg ranges
